name: Gulping Tide
description: Loose a tide of small mouths that each gulp a morsel from the soul they strike.

name: Maw Tether
description: Tether the foe's soul to a maw that feeds on him for as long as he struggles.

name: Ravener Ward
description: Hold a ward in the shape of a ravening mouth that swallows soul strikes.

name: Hollowing Cleanse
description: Hollow out a curse or an erosion lodged in an ally's soul by eating it away.

name: Devouring Surge
description: Surge outward in a wave of hunger that drains every soul it crosses.

name: Tithing Ravage
description: Gorge on one foe's soul and give a tithe of the drawn force to the nearest ally.

name: Starvation Seal
description: Seal a foe's soul against all inflow of force so that his reserve cannot refill.

name: Ravenous Host
description: Raise a host of ravenous mouths that feed on the foes and fill the user's allies.

name: Soul Absorption
description: Absorb a soul attack whole into the user's reserve and hold it as strength.

name: Ravener Blow
description: Strike a blow that hollows the foe's soul from within and leaves the body whole.

name: Famine Passage
description: Pass through a ward by eating the strength that holds it together.

name: Endless Maw
description: The school's closing move that opens a maw without end and takes a share of every soul in range scaled to the user's reserve.

name: Voracity Unbound
description: Strip every soul in a wide field of its force up to the destructive ceiling of its tier in one devouring.

name: Appetite Bolt
description: Loose a bolt of divine hunger that tears a share from the soul it strikes.

name: Appetite Chain
description: Wrap a chain of appetite about the foe's soul that drinks from him while it holds.

name: Appetite Aegis
description: Hold an aegis of hunger before the soul that eats the divine force of a strike.

name: Appetite Cleansing
description: Eat a curse of the divine kind from an ally's soul and leave it whole.

name: Appetite Surge
description: Surge a wave of divine appetite across a field and drain all it passes.

name: Appetite Ravage
description: Gorge on a single soul and fill the user to overflowing.

name: Appetite Edict
description: Declare an edict of hunger that presses down the will of every foe in range.

name: Appetite Host
description: Send a host of divine mouths over the field that feed the user and the allies.

name: Appetite Absorption
description: Absorb an attack of divine force whole and turn it to the user's strength.

name: Appetite Blow
description: Strike a blow of pure hunger that unravels the foe's soul from within.

name: Appetite Passage
description: Pass through any ward or wall of force by devouring its hold.

name: Divine Appetite
description: The school's closing move that spreads the divine appetite over a multitude and feeds the user by a measure of the reserve.

name: Ravening Dominion
description: Devour the force of a multitude and press down all who remain up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Final Devouring
description: Devour every soul in a vast field up to the destructive ceiling of its tier and leave the husks behind.
